coverLetter.salutation: Dear Union of Concerned Scientists Team,
body: I'm applying for the Strategic Communications Officer role because turning complex science and technology into clear, compelling communication is the throughline of my career, and UCS's mission of putting rigorous, independent science into action is exactly the work I want to help amplify.

For nine years I've built and run communications and campaigns end to end. I rebuilt the marketing and communications function for a 90+ location brand, owning messaging, creative, and multi-channel planning across digital and print; I grew a media audience by 50,000+ followers and 30,000+ email subscribers; and I earned national coverage through brand and campaign work. I also translate dense science into public-facing storytelling: I created a James Webb Space Telescope experience distributed to 400+ venues and led an education venture into a partnership with the ISS National Laboratory. Across all of it I coordinate creative, editorial, and program teams, manage projects to deadline, and track impact with tools like Google Analytics and SEO.

UCS's values, science in service of people and the planet, the courage to take principled stands, and the fight against disinformation, are ones I share, and I would be glad to bring a steady drumbeat of high-impact communications to your campaigns. I can confirm that the listed salary of $97,090 meets my expectations. Thank you for considering my application.
